notes: Detailed paraphrases of Core Rulebook Force Adept, Jedi Knight, and Sith Apprentice talents.

rules.name: Channel Aggression
rules.description: Feed on an enemy's vulnerability to deliver a burst of dark-side damage.

mechanics.use: Free action after a successful attack.
mechanics.trigger: You hit a flanked target or one denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.effect: Deal +1d6 damage per Force Adept class level, maximum +10d6.

rules.name: Channel Anger
rules.description: Enter a Force-fueled rage that improves melee offense but leaves you depleted.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 rage on melee attack and melee damage rolls.
mechanics.duration: 5 rounds plus Constitution modifier; afterward move -1 condition step.
mechanics.special: While raging, cannot use patient or concentration-dependent skills such as Mechanics, Stealth, or Use the Force.

rules.name: Crippling Strike
rules.description: Turn a critical hit into a lasting mobility injury.

mechanics.use: Free action on a critical hit.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the target's speed by half.
mechanics.duration: Until the target is restored to maximum hit points.

rules.name: Embrace the Dark Side
rules.description: Use dark-side powers more reliably at the permanent cost of light-side powers.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power with the dark-side descriptor.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the Use the Force check, but must keep the second result.
mechanics.special: After selecting this talent, you can no longer use Force powers with the light-side descriptor.

rules.name: Force Power Adept
rules.description: Specialize in one Force power and spend a Force Point to improve its activation check.

special: Force Adept or Force Disciple talent access

mechanics.effect: Roll the Use the Force check twice and keep the better result.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for a different known Force power; effects do not stack.

rules.name: Force Treatment
rules.description: Use the Force in place of medical training and work without normal medical supplies.

special: Force Adept or Force Disciple talent access

mechanics.effect: Use Use the Force instead of Treat Injury and count as trained in Treat Injury. Treat Injury rerolls apply to the substituted check under the same restrictions.
mechanics.special: You may administer first aid and treat disease, poison, or radiation without a medpac or medical kit.

rules.name: Fortified Body
rules.description: The Force renders your body immune to several environmental and biological threats.

special: Force Adept or Force Disciple talent access

mechanics.effect: You are immune to disease, poison, and radiation.

rules.name: Attune Weapon
rules.description: Bind a melee weapon to yourself through the Force for improved accuracy.

mechanics.effect: You gain +1 Force bonus on attacks while wielding the attuned weapon.
mechanics.duration: Indefinite until another rule ends the attunement.
mechanics.special: The bonus applies only when you wield it; other wielders receive no benefit.

rules.name: Empower Weapon
rules.description: Imbue a melee weapon so it deals an additional die of damage in your hands.

mechanics.effect: The weapon deals one additional weapon-damage die when wielded by you; for example, 2d8 becomes 3d8.
mechanics.special: Other wielders receive no bonus damage.

rules.name: Force Talisman
rules.description: Imbue a worn or carried object with protection for one defense.

mechanics.effect: While wearing or carrying it, gain +1 Force bonus to Reflex, Fortitude, or Will, chosen when created.
mechanics.special: Only one active talisman at a time. If destroyed, you cannot create another for 24 hours.

rules.name: Greater Force Talisman
rules.description: Extend your Force talisman's protection to all three defenses.

mechanics.effect: Your Force Talisman grants its +1 Force bonus to Reflex, Fortitude, and Will instead of only one defense.

rules.name: Force Fortification
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to turn a critical hit against you into an ordinary hit.

mechanics.cost: Spend 1 Force Point, even if you already spent one this round.
mechanics.trigger: An attack scores a critical hit against you.
mechanics.effect: Negate the critical; resolve the attack's normal damage instead.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Focus (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Gain an additional accuracy bonus with lightsabers.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on melee attacks with lightsabers, stacking with Weapon Focus.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Specialization (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Gain additional lightsaber damage beyond ordinary specialization.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 on melee damage with lightsabers, stacking with Weapon Specialization.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple lightsaber attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with lightsabers as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Severing Strike
rules.description: Choose maiming restraint instead of killing a target with an overwhelming lightsaber strike.

mechanics.trigger: Lightsaber damage equals or exceeds both the target's current hit points and damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: Deal half damage, move target -1 condition step, and sever one arm at wrist/elbow or one leg at knee/ankle.
mechanics.special: Arm loss prevents use of that hand and imposes -5 on Strength- and Dexterity-based checks. Leg loss knocks prone, halves speed and carrying capacity, and imposes the same -5. The persistent condition requires successful surgery; a cybernetic replacement removes these penalties.

rules.name: Ataru
rules.description: Use agility rather than raw strength to drive lightsaber damage.

mechanics.effect: Add Dexterity bonus instead of Strength bonus to lightsaber damage. When wielding two-handed, apply twice Dexterity bonus instead of twice Strength bonus.

rules.name: Djem So
rules.description: Answer a successful melee attack with an immediate counterstrike.

mechanics.trigger: An opponent hits you with a melee attack.
mechanics.effect: Immediately make one attack against that opponent.

rules.name: Jar'Kai
rules.description: Double the defensive value of Lightsaber Defense while wielding two lightsabers.

mechanics.trigger: Use Lightsaber Defense while wielding two lightsabers.
mechanics.effect: Gain twice its normal deflection bonus to Reflex Defense.

rules.name: Juyo
rules.description: Focus aggressively on a single foe and improve your first attack each round.

mechanics.target: One enemy in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Reroll your first attack roll against that enemy each round and keep the better result.

rules.name: Makashi
rules.description: Improve Lightsaber Defense while dueling with one blade in one hand.

mechanics.trigger: Use Lightsaber Defense while wielding one lightsaber in one hand.
mechanics.effect: Increase its deflection bonus by 2, still subject to a maximum total bonus of +5.

rules.name: Niman
rules.description: Adopt a balanced lightsaber stance that reinforces body and mind.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 to Reflex Defense and Will Defense.

rules.name: Shien
rules.description: Redirect deflected blaster bolts with exceptional accuracy.

mechanics.trigger: Use Redirect Shot after deflecting a blaster bolt.
mechanics.effect: Gain +5 on the redirected ranged attack roll.

rules.name: Shii-Cho
rules.description: Reduce the cumulative penalty for repeatedly blocking or deflecting attacks.

mechanics.effect: Each previous Block or Deflect attempt since the start of your last turn imposes -2 on later checks instead of -5.

rules.name: Sokan
rules.description: Tumble through threatened spaces with reliable economy of movement.

mechanics.effect: You may take 10 on Acrobatics checks to tumble even while threatened. Each threatened or occupied square tumbled through counts as only 1 square of movement.

rules.name: Soresu
rules.description: Retry a failed lightsaber defense against melee or ranged attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Fail a Use the Force check for Block or Deflect.
mechanics.effect: Reroll the failed check under the same circumstances.

rules.name: Trakata
rules.description: Exploit rapid lightsaber deactivation and ignition to feint in combat.

mechanics.use: Two swift actions while wielding a lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Make a Deception check to feint in combat.

rules.name: Vaapad
rules.description: Expand your lightsaber's critical threat range against foes you can still hit.

mechanics.effect: Lightsaber attacks score critical hits on natural 19 or 20.
mechanics.special: A natural 19 is not an automatic hit; if the attack still misses, it is not a critical hit.

rules.name: Dark Healing
rules.description: Drain a nearby creature's life to heal yourself.

mechanics.effect: On a hit, deal 1d6 damage per Sith Apprentice class level and heal the same amount; on a miss, no effect.

rules.name: Dark Scourge
rules.description: Gain a dark-side attack bonus against Jedi characters.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 dark-side bonus on attack rolls against them.

rules.name: Dark Side Adept
rules.description: Retry activation checks for Force powers tied strongly to the dark side.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power with the dark-side descriptor.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the Use the Force check, but must keep the second result.

rules.name: Dark Side Master
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to keep the better result when Dark Side Adept rerolls a power.

mechanics.trigger: Use Dark Side Adept to reroll a dark-side power's activation check.
mechanics.effect: Keep the better of the two Use the Force results.

rules.name: Force Deception
rules.description: Use the Force to cloak lies and substitute Use the Force for Deception.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Deception and count as trained in Deception. Deception rerolls apply to the substituted check under the same restrictions.

rules.name: Improved Dark Healing
rules.description: Drain life from twice the distance and still inflict partial harm on a miss.

mechanics.effect: Dark Healing's range becomes 12 squares. On a missed attack, the target still takes half damage and you heal the same amount.

rules.name: Wicked Strike
rules.description: Turn a lightsaber critical into a severe condition-track penalty.

mechanics.use: Free action on a critical hit.
mechanics.trigger: Score a critical hit with a lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Move the target -2 steps on the condition track in addition to resolving the critical hit.
